title: In the Lap of Mother Nature (Ha Pneh Ka Mei Mariang)
cultural_context: Hymn celebrating communion with Mother Nature in the Khasi hills, published in 'Ki Jingrwai Khasi'.
lyrics_khasi:
Ha pneh jong ka Mei Mariang
Nga sngew kmen ban shong,
Hapdeng ki soh ki syntiew
Ba phuh ha ka shnong;
Ki sim ki rwai ka sur
Ba pyntngen ia ka dohnud,
Ki um kiba tuid kynjai
Ki pynklet ia ka jynjar.

Hangne khlem jingkhihwin,
Khlem jingrhah pyrthei,
Ka mynsiem ka kiew sha bneng
Ban burom ia U Blei;
Mei Mariang ba bha,
Ri ia nga ha pneh,
Haduh ba ngan da poi
Sha khet ba la thmuh.
lyrics_english:
In the lap of Mother Nature
I rejoice to abide,
Amidst wild fruits and blossoms
Blooming across the hills;
The birds sing a sweet melody
That brings solace to my heart,
The crystal streams flowing peacefully
Washing away all sorrow.

Here free from worldly tumult,
Far from greedy ambition,
The spirit ascends to heaven
Venerating the Almighty God;
Kind Mother Nature,
Shelter me in your embrace,
Until my destined footsteps arrive
At the eternal throne.

khasi: Ha pneh jong ka Mei Mariang
Ki sim ki rwai ka sur
english: In the lap of Mother Nature
The birds sing a sweet melody
That brings solace to my heart,

khasi: Ka mynsiem ka kiew sha bneng
